title: keep going

items.content: Mouse scroll must not change selection in any panel; only keys do (FEN6)

summary: I took "keep going" as a yes on merging. RUS198 is merging #63 (subagent titles) into main once it has rerun the tests on the latest main. It will first check that the 3 failing sandbox tests also fail on plain main, and it won't merge if they fail only on its branch. FEN6 is still on the scroll fix, and I've told it to merge into main as soon as its tests pass, without waiting for you. From here…
